name: relative
body:
Range("A1:F6").Clear
On Error Resume Next
Range("C3:D4").FormulaR1C1 = "=RC[-2]+R[-1]C"
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Report = CStr(n)
For Each cell In Range("C3:D4")
Report = Report & "|" & cell.Formula & ":" & cell.FormulaR1C1 & ":" & TypeName(cell.FormulaR1C1)
Next cell
